mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 5.0% signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above 0.5% monthly indicates strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS exceed 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 1900 thousand units signals weak construction activity, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1900.

mechanism_narrative: High employment levels (PAYEMS > 135 million) indicate robust labor market conditions, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS exceeds 135 million.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in industrial production (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM) and GDP (GDPC1 > 0.5% QoQ) signals robust economic output, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both INDPRO and GDPC1 exceed their respective growth thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high industrial production growth (INDPRO > 1.0% MoM), economic activity expansion supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 1.0% MoM.
